verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships an official CLI, abctl, for running Airbyte deployments (docs-13), but it is a deployment/installation tool rather than an AI-native automation CLI, and there is no evidence of a CLI designed for programmatic pipeline management akin to agentic workflows (that role is instead filled by the API, Terraform provider, and PyAirbyte). missing for 10: evidence abctl (or another CLI) supports connection/sync management for AI-native agent workflows, evidence of AI-specific CLI features or agent integration via the CLI, independent corroboration of CLI usage.
